name: A-Block
description: A-Block is a Black Disciples-affiliated street gang based in Detroit, also known as Sherron Squad, Vic Gang, and Headshot Boyz. The group is cliqued up with 6-Deuce Dump$treet, Duke Gang, Mooksquad, AAD, and KYMB. The name A-Block also appears as a secondary identifier used by the Blood-affiliated SmokeCamp Bloods set operating around E. Seven Mile Rd., indicating possible name overlap with a separate organization.

sources.title: Understanding Hybrid and Mixed-Affiliation Groups in Metro Detroit
Profiles of Major Neighborhood Street Groups in Detroit
